versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Semantics of meta-class CpSoftwareClus- terBinaryManifestDescriptor The existence of the CpSoftwareClus- terBinaryManifestDescriptor represents the definition of the model of a Software Cluster Binary Manifest for a given Software Cluster . Because of this relation, it is necessary that CpSoftwareClusterBinaryMani- festDescriptor references the corresponding CpSoftwareCluster instead of being aggregated by it.
